source.description: Previously reviewed Higgsfield film set; project metadata comes from individual public source pages. This is not a complete platform inventory.

metricDefinitions.label: Credits spent
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of distinct public project credits, missing values excluded; duplicate project IDs counted once. Project-level usage, not independently verified film-only production cost.

metricDefinitions.label: Total size (GB)
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of distinct projects rounded published sizes, normalized with decimal GB (MB / 1000, TB * 1000). Not the size of final video files.

metricDefinitions.label: Model weight
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum(project generations * model share / 100) divided by total generations for projects with model shares and generations. This weights generations, not credit spend.

metricDefinitions.label: Review scope
metricDefinitions.definition: Previously reviewed public film set, excluding Higgsfield Studio productions; not a full inventory of the Higgsfield platform.

metricDefinitions.label: Total generations
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of published generation counts across distinct public projects; missing values excluded.

metricDefinitions.label: Views
metricDefinitions.definition: MIKAIFLIX catalog view counts collected on 2026-10-13; these are not Higgsfield view counts. Missing values are not zero.

metricDefinitions.label: Estimated USD equivalent
metricDefinitions.definition: User supplied approximate conversion: 1 USD = 22 credits. Model estimates allocate the total USD equivalent by generation weight, not actual model-specific credit charges.

evidenceFlow.title: Review scope
evidenceFlow.detail: Reuse the previously collected public film set. The report combines Higgsfield project metrics with the restored MIKAIFLIX catalog view counts; it is not a platform-wide census.

evidenceFlow.title: Public projects
evidenceFlow.detail: Fetch each HTTPS public Higgsfield project by username and film ID or Originals slug; verify festival ID, extract information, model stack. Cache raw HTML and parsed records.

evidenceFlow.title: Aggregation
evidenceFlow.detail: Nulls excluded from sums; report coverage. Model share weighted by project generations; decimal GB normalization. Cached retries are reproducible with collect.py.
